model: RPC Series room pressure sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone RPC series room pressure monitors with local alarm buzzer and BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The RPC is a Greystone room pressure monitor with native BACnet MS/TP. The pressure reading is one Analog Input; averaging time, high/low alarm limits, alarm delays, silence time and buzzer volume are Analog Values; Binary Values set alarm enable/test, backlight, units and range, and three Binary Inputs report the alarms.
notes: Points from the object list on page 1 of the setup guide; the object pages print the names with underscores (e.g. Pressure_Units).
Pressure objects follow BV 4 (in. w.c. or Pa); alarm limit defaults are half the selected range.
Access from the object pages: AV and BV Present_Value are read/write.

source.title: RPC Series Room Pressure Sensor - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, choose units and range, then read the room pressure (AI 1) and the alarm BIs. Set the alarm limits once at commissioning.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381003 (381000 + MAC); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
gotchas: Changing BV 4 (units) changes the units of AI 1 and the alarm limits.

points.name: Pressure Sensor Value
points.description: Room differential pressure in the selected units

points.name: Alarm High Limit
points.description: High pressure alarm limit (default +50 % of range)

points.name: Alarm Low Limit
points.description: Low pressure alarm limit (default -50 % of range)

points.name: Alarm On Delay
points.description: Alarm on delay, 1 s to 10 min (default 5 s)

points.name: Alarm Off Delay
points.description: Alarm off delay, 1 s to 10 min (default 5 s)

points.name: Alarm Silence Time
points.description: Buzzer silence time, 1-60 min, 0 = no reset (default 30)
